_note: Statewide program calendars (state parks, a state's outdoor recreation office) list events hours away from a region's hub, often without a map point or town. For these sites the reader publishes an event only when its place names a town from src/config/towns.ts within the region's radius, or one of the parks listed here (each within about 100 miles of the hub). Everything else is kept in the research tables as out of the region. Added 12 October 2026.
